_note: The entity graph for the four wedding sites, and the only place sameAs is written. lib/site-home.ts emits it as JSON-LD on every page of every host. One parent brand (Dream Wedding Builder) owns the one real profile, the Pinterest business account; each site is its own Organization whose parentOrganization is the brand, and the brand's parentOrganization is Spry Labs. A site's sameAs lists only profiles that resolve now and belong to that site; never its own host, never a profile borrowed from a sibling. A profile named but not yet claimed goes in profiles_pending and stays out of sameAs until scripts/entity/entity_backlink_watch.mjs sees it resolve and promotes it. Checked by validate:entity-graph (fast) and validate_rendered_seo_contract (built pages); watched weekly by .github/workflows/entity-backlink-watch.yml.
